nominations.basis: Probed with scripts/probe_candidate_pages.py: the court's own About the Court page reads (1,005 readable chars) and the verifier's own label test MATCHES the curated name in page content, as "U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit" -- the graph's wording word for word, digit ordinal included. The earlier pass probed only the homepage (www.ca11.uscourts.gov/), which labels the court "Eleventh Circuit | United States Court of Appeals" and does not match; this deeper page on the same host does. Two things had to change for this to be findable: the digit-token rule that made uncheckable_reason() return 'curated_count_label' for every numbered circuit was fixed after the earlier pass recorded, so the label test now runs at all, and the page was found by reading the court's own About link rather than stopping at the homepage. Not evidence: verify_base_graph.py re-fetches and decides for itself.
